text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel got injured during training, 
so I rushed over to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. There's no pain. With this...
choice_data_list: Are you planning to keep training?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If I take a break for a while, I 
worry that my condition might deteriorate.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'll check on the injury 
frequently! We'll take it one step at a 
time, starting with light training—
choice_data_list:
I can't allow that. You should rest right 
now.

If I decide it's dangerous, I'll stop you 
right away, got it?

right away, okay?

text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel herself must know all too 
well the terrors of injury. I persuade her 
that rushing now will render all her past 
patience meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Maybe I was getting a 
little ahead of myself...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, no need to rush, take it easy. 
Healing the injury comes first!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I will get some rest and focus on 
recovering.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I'll be even more careful than 
usual!

Sakura Laurel started with light training 
at the gym, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry. The pain is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'll give up on training. ...I felt it 
firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I can't push myself any further than this. 
I'll rest for a while.

With her injury worsening, Sakura Laurel 
rested quietly and focused on recovering.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I'll be even more careful than 
usual!

Sakura Laurel started with some light 
training at the gym.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. At this pace, I'll be fine...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—I feel no pain. I think I can keep going 
a bit longer!

Sakura Laurel continued training within 
reasonable limits, keeping her injury in 
mind.
